agent_briefing.description: The full briefing document provided by Agente00_TechLead. Must be non-empty.

initial_description.description: Raw project description from the original stakeholder request or context. May overlap with agent_briefing.

previous_prd_version.description: Optional: the existing PRD.md content if this is a revision cycle. Used to identify gaps without re-eliciting confirmed information.

session_number.description: Which elicitation session this is (1, 2, 3...). Defaults to 1.

focus_areas.description: Optional: limit question generation to specific categories. If empty, all 6 categories are covered.
